The video reportedly shows Trump chasing away the tiger, playfully wrestling with the animal, and eventually embracing it while “The Lion Sleeps Tonight” plays in the background. Trump also shared another AI-style video comparing himself to a lion fighting hyenas, with a narrator calling the lion the king of the jungle. The timing of these posts has raised questions about sensitivity and respect following a real-life tragedy at Yorkshire Wildlife Park in the UK. While the actual incident involved a fatal tiger attack, Trump's AI-generated clip presents a fictional scenario in which he appears to be playing with the animal like a hero. The contrast between the tragic event and the humorous imagery has sparked debate about social media, political image-making, and the use of AI-generated content after a death.
